pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with high-contrast, sharply defined edges. The boundaries exhibit significant pixel-level angularity and toothed or serrated protrusions rather than smooth curvilinear gradients.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-colored negative space. Intersections are clearly defined as nodal points (nodes) where three to four pathways meet. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively thin and uniform, though edges are characterized by jagged interfacing with the patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal ridge of the neck and shoulder presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background, consisting of dense, vertically oriented hair clusters.
